observations.body: Depth, unsearchable judgments, and doxology. Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past tracing out! For of him and through him and to him are all things. To him be the glory for ever! Amen.

payload.posture: Read Romans 11:33–36 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states depth, unsearchable judgments, and doxology. Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past tracing out! For of him and through him and to him are all things. To him be the glory for ever! Amen. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
